items.title: Fashionable Stars
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
It's time to become a star! Put on one of these stylish outfits, and show it off to everyone!

+ 6 teen skins
+ Cool outfits

items.title: Power Bunnies
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These 'Power Bunnies' have the latest in cybernetic armor and masks! Draw attention wherever you go with these advanced skins!

- 8 skins!
- Pick from a wide variety of colors, armor designs, and masks!

items.title: Skyblock Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs love Skyblock! Enjoy the popular gamemode while playing as your favorite mob!

- 8 skins!
- Different hoodies, sneakers, and designs so you can pick the outfit that suits you best!

items.title: Cat Collector
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Do you like cats? Do you want to boop their snoots and pet their soft fur? If the answer is yes then you have come to the right place! Welcome to the beautiful cat islands, home to unique magical cats.

-Collect 21 different cats
-Uncover their special abilities
-Feed them and take good care of them
-Tame your favorite furry companion today!

items.title: Sci-Fi Bunker
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Deep below the surface on an unknown planet in a galaxy far, far away a vast underground bunker is waiting to be explored! Roam the hallways and experience the height of technological advancement in this Sci-Fi adventure!

- Bunker survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: TREE HOUSE MANSION
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to live in a giant tree house mansion? Now it is time to party in this massive mansion in a giant tree! This mansion base is perfect to start your next survival world on.

+ Includes a giant house in a tree
+ Perfect for survival gameplay

items.title: BEDWARS!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Bedwars is a fun mini-game for all!
Protect your bed, collect resources, upgrade your tools and go to war!
+ 3 different bedwars maps!
+ Multiplayer only

items.title: Friendly Demons 2
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Friendly Demons 2!
Now back and friendlier than ever!
Grab your favorite skin and make friends on your favorite server!


+ 2 free skins.
+ 14 epic skins in total!

items.title: Meme Pack
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Are you the new leader of this generation? 
If so then the meme skin is for you. 
Perfect for pranks, scaring friends, or just making life awkward. 
Upgrade your skin and become a memer today!

+ 1 free meme.
+ 12 epic skins!

items.title: Millionaire Party House
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: This is your mansion! Party it up your way! All night, every night! Live it up like how you've dreamed!

items.title: Overpowered Tools
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
There are rumors of acient ruins hiding an armory of legendary tools. Such weapons and armor are fit for a god. You have found such a place. Curious to find out just how overpowered you can be?

+ Overpowered weapons and armor!
+ Custom textures for tools!
+ Huge Training Arena!
+ 4 roleplaying skins!

items.title: The Legion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The legion knows but one thing: to fight! To live is to fight, and the fight is the thrill of life. Will you join the legion?

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cool and dangerous attire inspired by thriller movies!

items.title: Icy Style
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
It's a frozen wonderland, and these teens are caught in the blizzard! Will the ice freeze them into statues? Or will they conquer this chilly challenge?

- 8 Frozen Teens!
- Perfect for the winter season!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Scary Clowns
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: Scary yet colorful clowns, these can make one awesome Halloween costume! You can never have too many skins to add to your horror collection. Which scary clown will you become to scare your friends and family!

items.title: Pumpkin Party
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: Join these pumpkins this Halloween for a night to remember. Didn't you know that pumpkins throw the best parties! Which of these skins is your favorite?

items.title: Beards & Staches
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Everyone knows facial hair can really pull a whole look together! Explore different styles of facial hair with these awesome skins!
- 10 unique skins
- by Zombeanie

items.title: Emo Fashion
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Express yourself with these super cool emo skins! They have Dark clothes, chains, spikes, and everything in between!
- 10 unique skins
- by Zombeanie

items.title: Clouds - Blue Skies
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Explore the skies using these lovely cloud skins! What's your favorite type of cloud?
- 10 unique skins
- by Zombeanie

items.title: Anime Drip
items.creator: Novasoft
items.description:
Flex on your friends with these anime teens! 

- 10 Dripped out anime skins to choose from!
- Perfect for roleplay, or to flex around on servers.

By Aurrora Skins

items.title: Costumed Friends
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description:
These stylish youngsters are super cool wearing their costumes! Everyone will see you! What are you waiting for? Get dressed and let's party!

+ 1 free skin!
+ 12 skins!

items.title: Skyblock Dimensions
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: Adventure to these dimensional islands, explore the immensity of available biomes, and have fun with your friends!

items.title: Size Modification
items.creator: ASCENT
items.description:
Go BIG or go SMALL. You can finally modify your player size, choosing from 7 different options! Play hide and seek with your friends or try beating the ender dragon with the biggest size possible!

+ 7 DIFFERENT SIZE OPTIONS
+ SUPER EPIC
+ FUNNY ROLEPLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

items.title: Trucks 2
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Whether a delivery of wood, goods for the supermarket or petrol. Grab a truck and hit the road!
Are you ready to expand the roads and drive your truck around the world?

+ 4 custom trucks
+ Single and multiplayer friendly

items.title: One Block !!
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
One Block like everyone loves it! Whenever you mine the block you get a random item or block!
Build from island to island and think carefully about how to use the few resources. Can you defeat the Ender Dragon? 

+Single and multiplayer friendly
